payload.detail: BLOCKER REMOVED 2026-09-18 (PR #2880, merged); THE DECISION IS STILL THE OWNER'S, which is why this row stays open. Both publishers the three WA services depend on are now registered in source-authority-registry.ts as named agencies: Department of Communities (WA) and City of Vincent. They are deliberately NOT the 'Government of Western Australia' catch-all an earlier block refused — a catch-all resolves every WA government document to one authority, whereas these two resolve only their own material. Both are catalogueIdentityOnly: true, so they are excluded from runtime retrieval classification and ranking is unchanged. WHAT IS LEFT IS THE OWNER DECISION THIS ROW ASKS FOR: registering a publisher admits no source. Passages Youth Engagement Hub and the two others still enter as unreviewed candidates at D band and cite nothing until signed off. They now appear in the clinical sign-off queue at /mockups/development/clinical-sign-off under Sources, which is where that decision can be worked.
